entrypoints.summary: The organizer states that players supply an HTML page that is opened in Chromium inside a VM.
The modified JavaScript-exposed TypedArrayPrototypeSetTypedArray builtin is the affected operation.

affected_components.role: The challenge modification comments out the target length variable and the source-length-plus-offset bounds check.

causal_paths.kind: HTML-supplied JavaScript to TypedArray set range check

code_slices.fixed: Compute targetLength and invoke CheckIntegerIndexAdditionOverflow so invalid source-length-plus-offset ranges branch to IfOffsetOutOfBounds.
code_slices.surrounding_context: The builtin comment states that if srcLength + targetOffset exceeds targetLength, it must throw a RangeError.
code_slices.vulnerable: The challenge patch comments out const targetLength = target.length and CheckIntegerIndexAdditionOverflow(srcLength, targetOffset, targetLength) otherwise IfOffsetOutOfBounds.

preconditions: The supplied HTML must execute JavaScript in the challenge's pinned Chromium build.
A TypedArrayPrototypeSetTypedArray call must be reached with a source length and target offset whose combined range exceeds the target length.

trigger_steps.payload_shape: HTML containing JavaScript; exact exploit script is not text-verifiable in this bundle.
trigger_steps.summary: Supply an HTML page to the service, which opens it in Chromium inside the VM.

trigger_steps.payload_shape: A typed-array copy request where srcLength plus targetOffset is greater than targetLength.
trigger_steps.summary: Invoke the affected typed-array set path using a source length and target offset that exceed the target range.

relation_candidates.rationale: The patch removes the guard that compares source length plus caller-controlled target offset against the target length.
Proceeding after the documented out-of-bounds check is removed creates the challenged operation's memory-safety primitive; exact primitive semantics are not demonstrated by an execution trace.
The stated effect of the omitted copy-range guard is violation of the target typed-array's intended bounds.
Restoring targetLength and CheckIntegerIndexAdditionOverflow routes invalid ranges to the out-of-bounds path.

impact.affected_asset: Memory safety of the Chromium renderer's V8 typed-array operation.
impact.attacker_capability: An actor whose supplied HTML executes JavaScript in the challenge Chromium instance can request a typed-array set operation whose source-length-plus-offset range exceeds the target length.
impact.security_effect: Violation of typed-array copy bounds in the challenged V8 build.

causal_trace.summary: Challenge-supplied HTML is opened by the pinned Chromium build in a VM.
The challenge patch comments out retrieval of the target typed-array length and comments out the check that srcLength plus targetOffset fits within that target length.
TypedArrayPrototypeSetTypedArray can proceed past the omitted out-of-bounds branch when copying a source typed array at an offset whose combined range exceeds the target array.

The removed range guard permits a script-controlled typed-array set request to violate the target typed array's intended copy bounds; this is a browser-engine memory-safety primitive, although this bundle does not directly show its precise read/write result or execution outcome.

primary_invariant.statement: For TypedArrayPrototypeSetTypedArray, srcLength plus targetOffset must not exceed target.[[ArrayLength]], otherwise the operation must take the out-of-bounds path and throw RangeError.
primary_invariant.violated_because: The challenge patch disables both targetLength acquisition and CheckIntegerIndexAdditionOverflow(srcLength, targetOffset, targetLength).

quality.review_notes: The primary patch directly establishes the omitted V8 bounds guard and its intended RangeError branch. The organizer statement establishes HTML-to-Chromium exposure. The supplied browser exploit artifact is not text-inspectable here, and no execution transcript, test result, or binary/image is present; therefore no concrete exploitation result, inter-stage handoff, or final root outcome is claimed for this record.

remediation.invariant_restored: Compute the target typed-array length and route srcLength plus targetOffset values that overflow or exceed that length to IfOffsetOutOfBounds, preserving the RangeError behavior documented in the code.
mitigation_classes: reject overflowing or out-of-bounds source-length-plus-target-offset combinations

affected_versions_or_commits.value: Chromium commit 1be58e78c7ec6603d416aed4dfae757334cd4e1e, as used by the challenge
